svg.title: All three-variable linear algebras from their traceless images
svg.desc: The traceless projection has scalar kernel. A subalgebra either contains the full scalar line and is a direct scalar extension, or is the graph of a character on its traceless image. Character means vanishing on every commutator. The complete character normalizer tables and joint homogeneous parameters classify the graphs, including zero-weight boundary characters and disconnected normalizer actions.
svg.text: From every projective type to every linear lift
h ⊂ gl₃(ℂ), π(M) = M − ⅓ tr(M)I, k = π(h) ⊂ sl₃(ℂ).
The scalar intersection h ∩ ℂI is either ℂI or zero.
Matrix conjugation preserves that intersection and the traceless image.
Full scalar kernel
Zero scalar kernel
h⁺(k) = k ⊕ ℂI
h(k,χ) = {X+χ(X)I : X ∈ k}
Subtract the scalar part of every lift.
χ is linear and χ([k,k]) = 0.
Conjugacy is exactly conjugacy of k.
Conjugacy transports the actual character.
Every graph parameter is classified under the full matrix normalizer
P k P⁻¹ = k′, χ′(PXP⁻¹) = χ(X), for every X ∈ k.
Perfect k: only χ=0. Matrix lines: complete eigenvalue / Jordan-block classification.
Every higher-dimensional projective type is included in the two tables of Theorem 8.13.
Four diagonal families use a joint homogeneous triple [a:c:t]
χ(D(a,c)) = t; (a,c) ≠ (0,0); scale a,c,t together.
F₄, K₂: exact triple. T₃: [a:c:t] ~ [c:a:t].
W₃: [a:c:t] ~ [a:a−c:−t].
A zero root weight permits one extra nilpotent character ε ∈ {0,1}.
The ordered flag fixes the F₄/K₂ parameters; quotient eigenline exchanges give T₃/W₃.
The remaining normalizer actions are explicit
Two diagonal generators: an exact pair, an exchange, a reflection, or S₃ on a triple.
Heisenberg n: four binary character types. U and U′: zero / nonzero character.
The regular nilpotent plane ⟨E,E²⟩: exactly (0,0), (1,0), (0,1).
Mixed Jordan, regular affine and nonsolvable scalar parameters have the stated exact values.
All exceptional zero-weight and repeated-eigenvalue cases are retained.
Proof: Proposition8.11, Lemma8.12 and Theorem8.13; full projective images: Theorem8.9.
Human source: Lie–Engel III, Chapter6 §§29–31, pp.109–121 (freely accessible original scan).
The figure concerns complex matrix algebras under GL₃ conjugacy and connected local subgroup germs.
